faq.title: eSIM FAQs
faq.q1: Is my smartphone compatible with Getly eSIM?
faq.a1: Most modern smartphones from Apple, Google, and Samsung support eSIM technology. You can check compatibility instantly in the app.
faq.q2: Do I lose my primary phone number when using Getly eSIM?
faq.a2: No. Your eSIM operates alongside your physical SIM, allowing you to keep your primary number active for WhatsApp and messages.
